scope: Correct planar bounds in the existing approximate STEP/WRL point-envelope checker; no footprint, model asset, board placement, gate threshold or routing change
defects: Non-quarter-turn Z rotation retained unrotated width and height, underbounding rotated rectangles
Negative XY scale used absolute values for the center as well as extents, losing off-origin reflections
correction: Retain signed scale for the center. Rotate extents using absolute sine/cosine contributions, preserving exact quarter-turn extents. Existing clockwise center-transform convention retained.

red_test.message: arbitrary rotation must bound all rectangle corners, not retain unrotated width/height

independent_evidence.reflection_witness: The same envelope scaled (-1,2) must occupy [-2,0]..[0,2]
independent_evidence.properties: 99 independent long-double four-corner cases: 11 positive/negative/cardinal/non-cardinal angles, three signed X scales and three signed Y scales, translated by (7,-3)
independent_evidence.historical_geometry: All 288 original fixture inputs retained and immutable fixture hash checked. Only known-bug 45-degree expectations replaced by an independent analytic envelope and unchanged fit/overlap thresholds; remaining captures still compared exactly.
independent_evidence.real_inventory: 62 footprint reports and 154 hardware asset hashes unchanged
